name: Roasted Carrots and Parsnips
description: A simple roasted vegetable dish featuring carrots, parsnips, and onions with a maple syrup and mustard glaze.
recipeIngredient: 1 lb parsnips, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 lb carrots, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Place parsnips, carrots, onions, oil, and thyme in a prepared baking dish; toss until vegetables are well coated with oil.
Roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine maple syrup and mustard.
Pour the maple syrup mixture over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Roast for another 20 to 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender and golden, stirring once.

keywords: roasted carrots, roasted parsnips, maple syrup glaze

_similar.name: Freezer Cole Slaw
_similar.description: A freezer coleslaw recipe with a sweet and tangy dressing, made with grated cabbage and optional vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat together vinegar, sugar, salt, water, celery seed, and mustard to make the syrup.
Grate or chop cabbage and other vegetables in a food processor.
Cover the cabbage mixture with the syrup and refrigerate overnight.
Place in a container, seal, and freeze.

_similar.name: Barley and Corn Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty barley casserole with corn, carrots, and garlic, perfect as a comforting side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy casserole. Cook onion, garlic, and carrots until the onion is softened, stirring frequently.
Stir in barley and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, cover, and bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.
Test that barley is tender. Stir in corn and parsley.
Return to the oven to heat through. Season with pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: barley casserole, corn, carrots, comforting side dish

_similar.name: Potato Soup
_similar.description: A creamy potato soup with carrots, onions, and bacon, finished with sour cream and butter for added richness.
recipeIngredient: 1 Oxo Chicken cube dissolved in 2 cups (8 oz) water + 1 cup water

recipeInstructions.text: Cook vegetables (potatoes, carrots) in 6 cups water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Microwave onions and butter until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked onion and butter mixture to the vegetables and stir.
Make a roux by stirring flour into 1 cup water until smooth, then add to the soup.
Add more water (up to 1 more cup) to achieve desired consistency.

_similar.keywords: potato soup, creamy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Hamburger Pie
_similar.description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.description: A classic coleslaw recipe with a tangy dressing made with white vinegar, sugar, and spices.

Keep shredded cabbage and other ingredients in a glass or enamel container.
Pour dressing over the cabbage mixture and refrigerate tightly covered for several hours before using.
